title: Ensemble Normalized Work Item Schema
description: Schema for the toolchain's normalized 'work item' shape (TRD-2026-8d825f54 TRD-012, PRD REQ-002, REQ-022; System Architecture 'Interfaces and Formats'). A tracker-category adapter capability that returns a work item (for example 'tracker.show') maps its tool's raw stdout into this shape via packages/development/lib/toolchain/mapping.js#mapOutput; the runner validates the mapped value against this schema before handing it back to a caller, and rejects a mismatch as BAD_OUTPUT without passing the data on (PRD REQ-002 AC-002-2). Only 'id' is required: adapters legitimately omit fields their underlying tool does not expose (for example a tracker with no comment API never produces 'comments'). 'additionalProperties' is left true at the top level so an adapter may carry extra passthrough fields this normalized shape does not name; this schema enforces only the shape of the fields it documents, it is not a closed/exhaustive contract.

id.description: The work item's id in its source tool, for example a Jira key or a beads id.

title.description: Short human-readable summary/title of the work item.

description.description: Full body/description text of the work item.

type.description: The work item's type as reported by its source tool (for example 'bug', 'story', 'task'); not constrained to an enum because trackers define their own, incompatible type vocabularies.

status.description: Normalized lifecycle status; adapters translate their tool's own status strings into one of these three via a capability's parse.statusMap (TRD-012).

priority.description: The work item's priority as reported by its source tool, normalized to a string (this schema's own choice, not mandated by the TRD -- a union of 'string'|'number' was considered and rejected to keep the schema in Ajv strict mode without warnings). Trackers that expose a numeric priority rank are expected to stringify it (e.g. '1') before this field is populated; TRD-012 does not define a normalized priority vocabulary beyond that.

labels.description: Freeform labels/tags attached to the work item.

id.description: The id of the work item this one depends on.

type.description: The dependency relationship's type as reported by the source tool (for example 'blocks', 'relates-to').

items.description: One dependency edge; only 'id' is required, matching the top-level work item's own required-field policy.

dependencies.description: Work items this one depends on.

id.description: The id of the dependent work item.

type.description: The dependency relationship's type as reported by the source tool.

items.description: One dependent edge; same shape as a 'dependencies' entry (this schema's own choice -- the TRD documents 'dependents[]' without an explicit item shape).

dependents.description: Work items that depend on this one.

items.description: One comment on the work item. Its shape is intentionally unconstrained beyond 'object' (this schema's own choice) because TRD-012's Implementation AC and System Architecture section document only that 'comments[]' exists on the work item, not a normalized comment shape.

comments.description: Comments on the work item, in source-tool order.

externalRef.description: A fully-qualified external reference to the work item in its source tool (for example a URL), when the tool exposes one.
